name: MLOps Lifecycle, Maturity & Governance
description: MLOps maturity levels (Level 0 Manual to Level 2 Automated CI/CD/CT), Model Governance, Model Cards, training reproducibility, audit trails, ethical gates, and regulatory compliance.

subskills.name: MLOps Maturity Framework (Levels 0, 1, 2)
subskills.description: Google MLOps maturity model: Level 0 (manual workflow), Level 1 (automated ML pipeline / CT), Level 2 (CI/CD pipeline automated deployment).

subskills.name: Model Cards & Standardized Documentation
subskills.description: Authoring standardized Model Cards: model details, intended use, factors, evaluation datasets, quantitative metrics, and ethical considerations.

subskills.name: End-to-End Model Lineage & Provenance Tracking
subskills.description: Tracing deployed model binary back to exact Git commit hash, DVC dataset hash, training environment parameters, and container image digest.

subskills.name: Model Governance, Review & Approval Gates
subskills.description: Role-based model approval gates before production promotion (Data Scientist -> ML Engineer -> Risk/Compliance Officer sign-off).

subskills.name: Ethical AI, Bias Auditing & Compliance Gates
subskills.description: Enforcing automated bias and fairness gates in CI/CD (disparate impact, equalized odds) using Fairlearn / AIF360 before model release.

subskills.name: Enterprise Model Catalog & Metadata Management
subskills.description: Centralizing model catalog assets in DataHub / MLflow, tracking model status, owners, input/output schemas, and SLAs across business units.

subskills.name: Deterministic Training & Environment Isolation
subskills.description: Ensuring bitwise training reproducibility: setting global random seeds (PyTorch/CUDA/NumPy), pinning dependencies, and deterministic CUDA ops.

subskills.name: Regulatory Compliance (EU AI Act, GDPR, HIPAA)
subskills.description: High-risk AI system compliance, Right to Explanation under GDPR, model auditing, data residency, and algorithmic impact assessments.

subskills.name: Model Incident Response & Post-Mortem Runbooks
subskills.description: Authoring post-mortem runbooks for silent model failure, feedback loops, data corruption, and establishing emergency rollback procedures.

cv.signal: Established enterprise MLOps governance, standardized Model Cards, and automated compliance gates

linkedin.signal: MLOps Governance, Model Management, and AI Compliance endorsements

assessment.signal: Passes MLOps Lifecycle, Maturity & Governance Assessment

junior.description: Understands MLOps maturity stages, authors standardized Model Cards, and sets up deterministic seed environments.

mid.description: Tracks full model lineage from data to binary, enforces CI/CD fairness gates, and integrates assets into enterprise model catalogs.

senior.description: Architects EU AI Act/GDPR regulatory compliance frameworks, establishes model risk runbooks, and drives enterprise MLOps transformation.
